title: Print Even Numbers
instructions:
Write a function called `printEvenNumbers` that takes an `Int` parameter `n` and prints all even numbers from 2 to `n` (inclusive if `n` is even), each on its own line.

For example, `printEvenNumbers(10)` should print:
```
2
4
6
8
10
```
hint: Try using `step`: `for (i in 2..n step 2)`. Or loop through 1..n and use an if to check `i % 2 == 0`.
